changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'workflow' AND TABLE_NAME = 'ItemStepTransition') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [workflow].[ItemStepTransition]( [FromItemStepID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [ToItemStepID] [bigint] NOT NULL, [Condition] [xml] NULL, [Date] [datetime] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_WorkflowItemStepTransition] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [FromItemStepID] ASC, [ToItemStepID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_WorkflowItemStepTransition_FromItemStep') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [workflow].[ItemStepTransition] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowItemStepTransition_FromItemStep] FOREIGN KEY([FromItemStepID]) REFERENCES [workflow].[ItemStep] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [workflow].[ItemStepTransition] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowItemStepTransition_FromItemStep] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_WorkflowItemStepTransition_ToItemStep') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [workflow].[ItemStepTransition] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowItemStepTransition_ToItemStep] FOREIGN KEY([ToItemStepID]) REFERENCES [workflow].[ItemStep] ([ID]) ALTER TABLE [workflow].[ItemStepTransition] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_WorkflowItemStepTransition_ToItemStep] END
